caption: The drawing depicts a tall, ornate object that appears to be a ceremonial or decorative item, rendered in grayscale. It consists of a cylindrical base that tapers slightly upward and transitions into a bulbous section adorned with vertical bands. Above this is a rounded, openwork section featuring intricate floral or vine-like patterns. Attached to this section and above are several small bells hanging by loops, evenly spaced around the structure. The upper portion is surmounted by an elaborate crown-like finial, also with openwork and ornamental details. The entire object is contained within a faint rectangular border, and the name "AARON EASTOUSKY" is written in the lower right corner, just outside the border. The shading suggests a metallic texture and highlights the three-dimensional form of the object.
title: Silver Ornament for Scroll
